name: Mastercraft Hardwood Lumber Inc
old_description: Welcome to Mastercraft Hardwood Lumber – your go-to source for hardwood, plywood, and custom moldings. Our family’s been serving the local community since 1983, providing premium lumber products for all kinds of projects, and doing whatever it takes to guarantee your complete satisfaction.
about:
Mastercraft Hardwood Lumber Inc has operated from Sparks, Nevada since 1983 as a family-owned lumber supplier. The company was established to serve the local community with hardwood, plywood, and custom millwork, and remains locally owned after four decades.

The business stocks a wide range of North American and exotic hardwoods—from alder to walnut—along with cabinet-grade and construction-grade plywood. Its workshop produces custom moldings, trim, and millwork to exact specifications, and it maintains a rotating inventory of live-edge slabs and epoxy systems for resin table projects. A showroom and lumber yard allow customers to inspect materials in person.

Mastercraft serves contractors, woodworkers, furniture makers, interior designers, and industrial paneling buyers. Its products are used in structural applications, cabinetry, fine furniture, and both interior and exterior design projects. The company also supplies branded lines such as Saroyan Hardwoods and Orepac.

The company emphasizes its local ownership, competitive pricing, and a satisfaction guarantee backed by repeat customers. It was founded to provide a versatile wood selection and custom millwork capability under one roof, aiming to be a single source for both raw lumber and finished profiles.
